# Precursor Labs

> Research on multi-agent architectures, markets, compute infrastructure, and decision-making systems under fast AI timelines.

Precursor Labs (precursorlabs.org) is a research company studying multi-agent
architectures, markets, and compute infrastructure that become important under
fast AI timelines.

## Writing

- Blog: https://precursorlabs.substack.com/
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/precursorlabs

## About

We are engineers, financiers, and company builders solving bottlenecks to rapid
capability takeoff.

We believe the next generation of autonomous systems will need to coordinate
with humans and agents, reason in dynamic environments, and allocate resources
under uncertainty.

Our work focuses on three areas:

- Multi-agent RL systems: why specialized AI systems dominate constrained
  environments while frontier LLMs still struggle with dynamic tasks like
  negotiation, sales, persuasion, trading, and fundraising.
- Emerging market structure around AI buildout: how capital markets, compute,
  energy, GPU depreciation, and project finance shape the rate and direction of
  AI development.
- Decision-making infrastructure: how verification, trust, reward modeling, and
  market design shape coordination between humans, agents, and organizations.

We are especially interested in partners working on MARL, AI infrastructure,
compute finance, market design, frontier-model workflows, and long-horizon
technical systems.
